_comment: What the `days_remaining` field means, for the server that fills it in
and the screens that read it.
It is signed: negative once the certificate is past its expiry, and null
when the row carries no expiry date at all. Zero is the instant of
expiry and nothing else -- time left rounds up, time past rounds down.
`hours_from_now` is how far the expiry date sits from now; `expected` is
the number the server must publish for it. `buckets` then says what a
given published number means, which is what every badge, colour and
threshold in the UI is deciding.

published.why: the edge of the expiry window
half a day left still reads as a day, never as expired
an hour left is not zero
an hour past is already a day ago, not zero
long expired, and the screen says how long
no expiry date is not the same as expired

buckets.why: nothing to say about a row with no expiry date
